records.jp: ふー……。<CR>この辺のは、一旦片づいたかな
records.en_original: Phew... Looks like we cleaned up everything around here for now.
records.en: Phew... Looks like we cleaned up everything around here for now.

records.jp: あれ？　あそこに誰かいる……？
records.en_original: Huh? Is there someone over there?
records.en: Huh? Is there someone over there?

records.jp: あ、お兄ちゃん
records.en_original: Ah, big brother.
records.en: Ah, big brother.

records.jp: お兄ちゃんって……その呼び方、もしかして……
records.en_original: Big brother? That nickname means...
records.en: Big brother? That nickname means...

records.jp: かん、な……？
records.en_original: Kanna?
records.en: Kanna?

records.jp: えへへ、バレちゃった
records.en_original: Hehe, you found me out.
records.en: Hehe, you found me out.

records.jp: かんな、何があった？<CR>その見た目はいったい……
records.en_original: Kanna, what happened? Why do you look like that?
records.en: Kanna, what happened? Why do you look like that?

records.jp: それはねー……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: コモンをハッキングしたから
records.en_original: I hacked the Common.
records.en: I hacked the Common.

records.jp: ハッキング！？
records.en_original: Hacked?!
records.en: Hacked?!

records.jp: 今、外の世界とコモンは完全に遮断されてる
records.en_original: Right now, the outside world and the Common are completely cut off from each other.
records.en: Right now, the outside world and the Common are completely cut off from each other.

records.jp: そんなこと、どうやって……
records.en_original: How did you even do that?
records.en: How did you even do that?

records.jp: 一つ前の世界で教えてもらったんだー
records.en_original: I learned it in the previous world!
records.en: I learned it in the previous world!

records.jp: 一つ前の世界？<CR>何を言ってるんだ……
records.en_original: Previous world? What are you talking about?
records.en: Previous world? What are you talking about?

records.jp: どうして、そんなことをしたの？
records.en_original: Why did you do something like that?
records.en: Why did you do something like that?

records.jp: かんな、この世界が欲しいんだー
records.en_original: I want this world, you see!
records.en: I want this world, you see!

records.jp: いいでしょ？<CR>どうせこのままだったら、あとちょっとで消えちゃうし
records.en_original: That's okay, right? Either way, if things stay like this, it'll all be gone soon anyway.
records.en: That's okay, right? Either way, if things stay like this, it'll all be gone soon anyway.

records.jp: けど、かんなの世界の技術を使えば<CR>この世界を存続させることができる
records.en_original: But if I use the technology from my world, I can keep this world alive.
records.en: But if I use the technology from my world, I can keep this world alive.

records.jp: みんなにとって１００％いい未来になるかは<CR>わからないけど
records.en_original: I can't say for sure if it'll be the perfect future for everyone.
records.en: I can't say for sure if it'll be the perfect future for everyone.

records.jp: でも、消えちゃうよりマシでしょ？
records.en_original: But, it's better than just disappearing, right?
records.en: But, it's better than just disappearing, right?

records.jp: ……あなた、何者なの？
records.en_original: ...Who are you?
records.en: ...Who are you?

records.jp: ……もう、ここまで来て、<CR>キャラ作るのもおかしいか
records.en_original: Well, I guess there's no point in pretending anymore after coming this far.
records.en: Well, I guess there's no point in pretending anymore after coming this far.

records.jp: わたしは遠い世界線から来た、時の旅人
records.en_original: I'm a traveler from a distant timeline.
records.en: I'm a traveler from a distant timeline.

records.jp: 数え切れないほど繰り返し、この世界を生きてきた
records.en_original: I've lived through this world more times than I can count.
records.en: I've lived through this world more times than I can count.

records.jp: わたしの世界を救うために
records.en_original: All to save my own world.
records.en: All to save my own world.

records.jp: 「繰り返し、この世界を生きてきた」……？
records.en_original: Lived through this world over and over?
records.en: Lived through this world over and over?

records.jp: 「わたしの世界」って……<CR>じゃあ、かんなはどこから来たの？
records.en_original: "Your own world"? Then, where did you come from?
records.en: "Your own world"? Then, where did you come from?

records.jp: かんな！？
records.en_original: Kanna?!
records.en: Kanna?!

records.jp: あらあら、こんなところでお会いするなんて
records.en_original: My, my, fancy meeting you here.
records.en: My, my, fancy meeting you here.

records.jp: 駒川さん！？<CR>本部から呼び出されてたんじゃ……
records.en_original: Uta?! Weren't you called in to headquarters?
records.en: Uta?! Weren't you called in to headquarters?

records.jp: ささっと終わらせちゃいました！<CR>詩ちゃん、しごできなので♡
records.en_original: I wrapped that up nice and quick! Uta gets things done!
records.en: I wrapped that up nice and quick! Uta gets things done!

records.jp: それが嘘か本当かはどうでもいい。<CR>けど、そっち側に立ってるってことは――
records.en_original: Whether that's true or not doesn't matter. But since you're standing over there...
records.en: Whether that's true or not doesn't matter. But since you're standing over there...

records.jp: 「隷属化は解いていないはずだが？」
records.en_original: I haven't released the subjugation yet, though.
records.en: I haven't released the subjugation yet, though.

records.jp: ええ、リーダークンは確かにあの時<CR>“首輪”をつけてくれました
records.en_original: Yes, you did put that collar on me back then.
records.en: Yes, you did put that collar on me back then.

records.jp: 本気で気に入ってたんですよ。<CR>愉しかったな～、リーダークンの言いなりになるの
records.en_original: I actually really liked it, you know? It was so much fun, doing whatever you said.
records.en: I actually really liked it, you know? It was so much fun, doing whatever you said.

records.jp: ただ解除の鍵は持っていた、それだけです
records.en_original: But I just happened to have the key to take it off, that's all.
records.en: But I just happened to have the key to take it off, that's all.

records.jp: ……も～、構ってちゃんで困りますね
records.en_original: Sheesh, always craving attention—you're such a handful.
records.en: Sheesh, always craving attention—you're such a handful.

records.jp: わかりました。少しだけ相手してあげます
records.en_original: All right, I'll play along for just a little bit.
records.en: All right, I'll play along for just a little bit.

records.jp: 平原……？
records.en_original: Hiori?
records.en: Hiori?

records.jp: えっ、なに？<CR>なんであんなに戦車がたくさん……
records.en_original: Huh, what? Why are there so many tanks?
records.en: Huh, what? Why are there so many tanks?

records.en_original: *Gasp*
records.en: *Gasp*

records.jp: 平原、一番隊と共にそいつらを殲滅しろ
records.en_original: Hiori, wipe them out with squad one.
records.en: Hiori, wipe them out with squad one.

records.jp: 了解です！
records.en_original: Roger that!
records.en: Roger that!

records.jp: 詩ちゃん、久しぶりだね
records.en_original: Long time no see, Uta.
records.en: Long time no see, Uta.

records.jp: ……なるほど、そういうことですか
records.en_original: I see. So that's how it is.
records.en: I see. So that's how it is.

records.jp: さすが司令、刺激的です！<CR>一気に形勢逆転されちゃいました
records.en_original: As expected from the commander—always thrilling! The tables have turned in an instant.
records.en: As expected from the commander—always thrilling! The tables have turned in an instant.

records.jp: ゾクゾクしちゃいますね～、こうでなくちゃ
records.en_original: This is giving me chills—this is how it should be!
records.en: This is giving me chills—this is how it should be!

records.jp: あらあら……これは嬉しい驚きですね。<CR>そんなに好戦的な子でしたっけ？
records.en_original: Oh my, what a pleasant surprise. I didn't realize you were this much of a fighter.
records.en: Oh my, what a pleasant surprise. I didn't realize you were this much of a fighter.

records.jp: 本当は、こんなことしたくない。<CR>ちゃんと話し合って、わかってもらいたいけど――
records.en_original: Honestly, I don't want to do this. I'd really rather talk things through and have you understand me, but—
records.en: Honestly, I don't want to do this. I'd really rather talk things through and have you understand me, but—

records.jp: 詩ちゃんは、こうしないとダメだから。<CR>ただ話し合ってってお願いしても、聞いてくれないから
records.en_original: But with you, this is the only way. Just asking to talk it over isn't enough. You'll never listen.
records.en: But with you, this is the only way. Just asking to talk it over isn't enough. You'll never listen.

records.jp: ふふっ、嬉しいですね～
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm so happy right now!
records.en: Hehe, I'm so happy right now!

records.jp: あのかわいらしいだけだったお花ちゃんが、<CR>こんな素敵なトゲを持つなんて……
records.en_original: That cute little flower has such gorgeous thorns now.
records.en: That cute little flower has such gorgeous thorns now.

records.jp: 是非とも味わってみたいとこですけど……、<CR>う～ん、こちらもそんなに暇じゃないんですよ～
records.en_original: I'd love to see them for myself, but... Hmm, I'm kind of busy right now.
records.en: I'd love to see them for myself, but... Hmm, I'm kind of busy right now.

records.jp: ここは一旦引くのが得策ですかね。<CR>またお会いしましょう
records.en_original: Maybe it's best I retreat for now. See you again soon!
records.en: Maybe it's best I retreat for now. See you again soon!

records.jp: 司令、これはいったい……。<CR>どういう状況ですか？
records.en_original: Commander, what is this... What's going on here?
records.en: Commander, what is this... What's going on here?

records.jp: お前たちに、渡すものがある
records.en_original: There's something I need to give you.
records.en: There's something I need to give you.

records.jp: 指輪……日菜子が使っているのと同じやつ？
records.en_original: A ring... Is it the same as the kind that Hinako wears?
records.en: A ring... Is it the same as the kind that Hinako wears?

records.jp: そうだ
records.en_original: That's right.
records.en: That's right.

records.jp: どうしてこれを！？
records.en_original: Why do you have that?!
records.en: Why do you have that?!

records.jp: 先ほど助言を受けてな。<CR>ＡＡＳＡと話をした
records.en_original: I got some advice just a moment ago. I spoke with the AASA.
records.en: I got some advice just a moment ago. I spoke with the AASA.

records.jp: コズミックファング奪還のために力を貸してほしい、と
records.en_original: They asked if we'd lend our strength to take back the Cosmic Fang.
records.en: They asked if we'd lend our strength to take back the Cosmic Fang.

records.jp: 助言って……
records.en_original: "Advice"?
records.en: "Advice"?

records.jp: その様子だと、お前の前にも姿を現したようだな
records.en_original: From your reaction, it seems they appeared before you as well.
records.en: From your reaction, it seems they appeared before you as well.

records.jp: 結果的にＡＡＳＡは話に乗り、平原と援軍、<CR>そしてその指輪を寄越したというわけだ
records.en_original: In the end, the AASA agreed. They sent Hiori, reinforcements, and that ring.
records.en: In the end, the AASA agreed. They sent Hiori, reinforcements, and that ring.

records.jp: 私はそれを、今の窮地を救う道具として<CR>有用だと考え、お前たちに渡した
records.en_original: I believe that is the tool that'll help us out of our current predicament, so I'm giving it to you.
records.en: I believe that is the tool that'll help us out of our current predicament, so I'm giving it to you.

records.jp: その指輪は、コモンから力を引き出し、<CR>飛躍的な強さを与える
records.en_original: That ring will draw out power from the Common and give you incredible strength.
records.en: That ring will draw out power from the Common and give you incredible strength.

records.jp: イローデッドがつけた事例はないが、<CR>理論上はかなりの相乗効果がある
records.en_original: There has never been a case of an Eroded wearing one, but in theory, it should have a synergistic effect.
records.en: There has never been a case of an Eroded wearing one, but in theory, it should have a synergistic effect.

records.jp: 指輪を使うことによるリスクは……<CR>もうあの子から聞いているか
records.en_original: The risks of using the ring...you've probably already heard them from her.
records.en: The risks of using the ring...you've probably already heard them from her.

records.jp: 使うか使わないかは、お前たちに委ねる
records.en_original: Whether you use it or not, that's up to you.
records.en: Whether you use it or not, that's up to you.

records.jp: 全員整列しろ
records.en_original: All units, line up!
records.en: All units, line up!

records.jp: 今まで、本当によく頑張ってくれた
records.en_original: You've all really worked hard up to now.
records.en: You've all really worked hard up to now.

records.jp: 特に、ここまでまとめ上げてくれたリーダーには、<CR>私から最大の礼を
records.en_original: Especially you, Leader. For bringing everyone together—I offer you my deepest gratitude.
records.en: Especially you, Leader. For bringing everyone together—I offer you my deepest gratitude.

records.jp: 日ノ杜特殊部隊、最後の出動だ。<CR>悔いのないよう、尽力するように
records.en_original: This is the final mission for the Hinomori Special Forces. Give it everything you've got—no regrets!
records.en: This is the final mission for the Hinomori Special Forces. Give it everything you've got—no regrets!

records.jp: はい！
records.en_original: Yes, Commander!
records.en: Yes, Commander!

records.jp: 余りに残酷すぎます
records.en_original: It's just too cruel...
records.en: It's just too cruel...

records.jp: だって詩帆たちは、きっと指輪を使って雫世界を……<CR>そんなこと、する必要ないのに……
records.en_original: Because Shiho and the others...I know they'll try to use the ring to make the Oasis, but they really don't have to do that.
records.en: Because Shiho and the others...I know they'll try to use the ring to make the Oasis, but they really don't have to do that.

records.jp: お前に言われたくはないな
records.en_original: You're the last person I want to hear that from.
records.en: You're the last person I want to hear that from.

records.jp: 彼らは、きっと指輪を望む。<CR>その時に手ぶらだったら、歯がゆいだろう
records.en_original: They'll definitely want the ring. Wouldn't it be frustrating to show up empty-handed at that moment?
records.en: They'll definitely want the ring. Wouldn't it be frustrating to show up empty-handed at that moment?

records.jp: ねえ、リーダー
records.en_original: Hey, Leader.
records.en: Hey, Leader.

records.jp: ちょっとだけ、別行動してもいい？
records.en_original: Mind if I do my own thing for a little bit?
records.en: Mind if I do my own thing for a little bit?
